title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S40 E13 — Last Minute Company
Ree Drummond shares a foolproof plan for an impromptu Tex-Mex dinner party; the menu includes Chili-Orange Steak Street Tacos, Corn and Black Bean Salad and Strawberry Tres Leches Cake.

description:
S08 E02 — Jeffrey Garten
Jeffrey Garten joins Ina Garten to share highlights from their 60 years together, from love-at-first-sight encounters to their long-distance challenges. Ina makes Easy Butternut Squash and Apple Soup, and Jeffrey learns to make Challah French Toast.

description:

Hoda Kotb joins Ina Garten to talk about memories and game-changing moments; Ina shows Hoda how to assemble an Easy Mezze Board with Marinated Herbed Feta that is perfect for effortless entertaining; they make Fried Chicken Sandwiches.

description:
S36 E12 — Family-Style Brunch
"The Kitchen" hosts a family-style brunch; Jeff Mauro makes a Double Decker Monte Cristo, Katie Lee Biegel tosses up a fresh Spinach Salad with Grilled Chicken and Pickled Strawberries; Sunny Anderson serves a satisfying Baked Turmeric Oatmeal.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S37 E01 — Recipe Refresh
Katie Lee Biegel shares a recipe for a tuna noodle casserole; Geoffrey Zakarian pairs a strawberry saketini with coconut tempura shrimp; Jeff Mauro makes a Reuben sandwich.

description:

Guy Fieri sends talented chefs running through the aisles of Flavortown Market for the chance to make some serious dough; they face real-world challenges as they compete to be the last chef standing in this high-stakes cooking competition.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S39 E04 — All-Star Fruit!
Guy Fieri invites three chefs to take on a 60-minute multi-course fruit showdown; before they can cook their dishes, the chefs must compete in an auction and outbid each other for exclusive rights to the fruit they'll feature.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S38 E09 — Beat the Judges: Frozen Food Feast
Guy Fieri invites three chefs to prove they're the King of the Chill by outcooking each other in a frozen food fight; they make their best seafood dinner using just frozen items before the winner gets a shot at taking on the judge of their choice.

description:

description:

description:

The final teams turn classic children's stories into scary tales for the all-stars championship title, the hallowed prize belts and 50,000 dollars.

Twisted bedtime stories come to life as Jonathan Bennett asks the five remaining teams to create terrifying moving showpieces inspired by classic tales; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide which team's story has come to an end.

description:

Ree Drummond tries to win back her husband; she makes the Farmer's Breakfast, with over-easy fried eggs, honey-glazed ham, fried sausage and bacon, plus crispy potato bits and sticky buns; Ree versus her own restaurant.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S21 E03 — Cheap and Easy
Ree has been stocking up for four make-ahead meals that are as cheap as they are easy to make; her recipes include inexpensive slow cooker teriyaki ribs with quick slaw, Tex-Mex meatballs, BBQ chicken baked potatoes and a cheesy rigatoni pepper bake.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S31 E07 — New Weeknight Favorites
Ree Drummond dishes up new favorites that add wow to weeknights, including a new take on cheeseburger sliders, a quick skillet of rigatoni with broccolini and sausage, an easy tomato pie, and pretzel-crusted chicken strips.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S37 E03 — Make-Ahead Brunch
Ree Drummond cooks make-ahead savory, sweet and sippable items for brunch parties, including French onion frittata, a one-pan lemon blueberry French toast casserole, glazed cherry almond rolls and a spicy Tex-Mex Bloody Mary.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S35 E10 — French Bistro Faves
The crew celebrates French bistro classics: Jeff Mauro serves up Classic French Onion Soup; Geoffrey Zakarian and Sunny Anderson team up for Beef Bourguignon and Creamy Mashed Potatoes; Alex Guarnaschelli bakes a signature Pear Tarte Tatin.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S40 E07 — Kitchen Comebacks
The kitchen is bringing back old-school favorites with tasty updates, including beef stroganoff with egg noodles, chicken Kiev with peas and carrots and stuffed cabbage rolls; the hosts chat about the new season of "Alex vs America!"

title: Kitchen Nightmares
description:
S02 E04 — Kindred
A vegan restaurant grappling with direction and disorganization needs help.

title: Kitchen Nightmares
description:
S02 E09 — Leo's
A family tragedy leaves Leo's Italian Grill on the decline; customers are met with low-quality ingredients and a lack of customer service; Gordon is determined to help the owner rediscover his dream of operating a vibrant restaurant.

title: Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service
description:
S01 E03 — Mrs. White's Golden Rule Café
Gordon surveils and works to save a legendary soul food café on the verge of losing its legacy.

title: Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service
description:

Gordon must neutralize the threat of vermin and unkempt kitchen habits at a Philadelphia restaurant and help the owner pass the torch to her children.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Food Network's Jet Tila and chef Carla Hall hope to get sweet revenge over Bobby Flay; they bring in Asian food specialists chef Dan Jacobs and chef Tony Nguyen to dodge Bobby's curveballs and take home a win.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S31 E02 — Just Dill With It
Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro of "The Kitchen" aim to take down Bobby Flay; chefs Kathy Fang and Natascha Hess get into a pickle with the star ingredient.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

title: Beat Bobby Flay

Scott Conant and Eric Adjepong unite with chefs Dane Blom and Emme Ribeiro Collins to gang up on Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Chefs Kathy Fang and Nate Appleman lost once, but they're back to make sure that doesn't happen again. Brooke Williamson and Tiffany Derry cheer them on to victory over Bobby Flay.

description:

Sunny Anderson and TV host Nina Parker conspire with chefs John Cleveland and Michael Fiorelli to beat Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay

Powerhouse chefs Antonia Lofaso and Ayesha Nurdjaja recruit competitors Pete Amadhanirundr and Evelyn Garcia for a fierce showdown against Bobby Flay.

description:

Katie Lee and Zac Young want to scare up a victory, but Bobby Flay isn't giving up without a fright; pastry chefs Michael McGowan and Kareem Queeman have a scream at the spooky star ingredient.

description:

description:

Host Jesse Palmer tasks 16 top pastry chefs with crafting an elevated plated dessert in their signature style inspired by their assigned flavor and texture profile; judges Duff Goldman and Sherry Yard decide who makes it to the next round.

Host Jesse Palmer asks the 10 remaining chefs to reinvent a classic dessert with a modern twist; to impress judges Duff Goldman and Amaury Guichon, the bakers must craft a geometric layered mousse cake inspired by an assigned conceptual theme.

description:

Stay-at-home mom Cristina can't believe she's taking on chef Geoffrey Zakarian in a surprise cooking competition; Eddie Jackson has more up his sleeve when he presents the star ingredient, and Cristina will have to outchef a pro to take home $5,000.

description:

Home cook and entrepreneur Trent is stunned when Eddie Jackson gives them the chance to face off against celebrity chef Rocco DiSpirito; Trent must wow the judges to get one vote and keep Rocco from taking the win.

description:
S03 E11 — Mushroom Melee
Eddie Jackson surprises home cook Jessie Flores with a wild mushroom throwdown against the chef Stephanie Izard; a panel of judges off the streets of New York City decide if Jessie's mushroom meal is worthy of $5,000.

title: Outchef'd
description:
S03 E07 — A Cut Above
Eddie Jackson surprises home cook and lifelong "The Kitchen" fan Natalie Dargham with a steak showdown against celebrity chef Jeff Mauro; a panel of judges from the streets of New York City decides if Natalie will walk away $5,000 richer.

title: Outchef'd
description:
S03 E12 — Wing and a Flair
After three seasons of hosting, Eddie Jackson decides it's now his time to compete against home cook Komal Montgomery; Ted Allen steps in as guest host as Eddie and Komal try to wing it in a battle of quail.

title: Chopped
description:
S26 E01 — A Chopped Halloween
Halloween-themed ingredients including real blood and fake eyeballs are featured in the first round; the competitors get dead serious about their Halloween entrées.

title: Chopped
description:

The judges see what a drag queen, a witch, a medieval re-enactor and a bloody-faced warrior will cook for them; chefs must prepare a pork tenderloin entrée; cooks encounter a spiky fruit and clever cookie-crumb creation.

title: Chopped
description:
S35 E07 — Spooked
Creepy surprises and freaky finds for Halloween; special meat platter in round one; frightening ingredient is staring back at the chefs from the entrée basket; the two finalists get hyped up on Halloween candy as they scare up some creative desserts.

title: Chopped
description:
S39 E10 — Halloween Hijinks
Spooky fun is found in the first round, including a scary sight in a martini glass; witch's cauldron holds a green, savory surprise in the entrée basket; it's demolition day at the haunted gingerbread house as the final two chefs make their desserts.

title: Chopped
description:
S43 E07 — Horror Flick Halloween
In a Halloween-themed competition, the four chefs face ingredient baskets packed with a nod to horror movies, including a cringeworthy surprise in the appetizer basket and entrée ingredients liver, fava beans and Chianti.

title: Chopped
description:
S56 E11 — Halloween Spooktacular
It's Halloween, and the basket goblins have found ingredients that are positively spooky; the chefs struggle to wrap their heads around a pasta brain, try to make something glorious out of something gross and take their shot with tasty syringes.

description:

Chefs Maneet Chauhan and Brooke Williamson swing by Bobby Flay's kitchen with a drop challenge to erase him off the board, while chefs Jocelyn Law-Yone and Rasheeda Purdie school Bobby on their signature dishes.

description:

Sunny Anderson and ESPN's Sage Steele share a military connection with chefs Star Maye and Marie Yniguez as they put Bobby Flay through a set of drills.

Alex Guarnaschelli and James Austin Johnson leave a lasting impression on Bobby Flay as he tries to beat chefs Stephanie Cmar and David Standridge.

description:

Bobby Flay meets his match when meteorologist Ginger Zee and Sunny Anderson storm the kitchen with chefs Basil Yu and Sanjay Rawat.

A virtuoso of eclectic global flavors, Chef Angelo Sosa, is bringing his worldly knowledge to take on Bobby Flay's Titans in the Triple Threat kitchen. Michelin-starred chef Michael White judges.

"The Kitchen" eases back into entertaining with a creamy burrata and sweet fig appetizer, easy white bean and mushroom soup and pan-roasted filet mignon with green peppers; there's also dessert, plus a game to get party guests laughing.

Sharing twists on takeout and making delivery favorites at home, including orange peel chicken, souvlaki, a giant double-decker taco, and spicy pork lettuce wraps; the hosts have some kitchen hacks that will change people's lives.

A devoted father sinks his retirement savings into a neighborhood bar that shaped his life, but his loyal customer base is literally dying off; Jen Agg and Aarón help him confront his fear of change and allow his daughter to step up to the plate.

An Indian restaurateur facing bankruptcy must confess to his family.

A proud Italian immigrant must give up control of his kitchen.

Guy Fieri challenges three chefs to prove their pork chops by making a bacon dish, and the winner goes head-to-head with an all-star judge to see who can bring home the bacon.

Three top chefs from Northern California's wine country compete to show off their vintage; Guy Fieri welcomes them to the market with a gift basket full of local artisanal goods that they must feature in their signature dish.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S32 E05 — All-Star Rush
Four chefs who feel the need for speed compete in Grocery Rush; in a race against the clock, they'll serve a brunch in only 20 minutes and make their favorite noodle dish using 10 ingredients or fewer.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S35 E11 — 10 Pounds, Two Rounds
Guy Fieri challenges four chefs to prepare two complete meals using no more than 10 lbs. of ingredients; after the chefs use half their weighted groceries to make a hearty hot lunch, they grab two items from the clearance rack to make a dinner.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S36 E07 — Red Light Special Extravaganza
Guy Fieri has plenty of deals to welcome four chefs to Flavortown Market, with red light specials in all 10 aisles; using the red light specials, the chefs must create a fried feast before making a pork dish that's limited to 11 ingredients or fewer.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S38 E10 — Three Course Couples
Three chefs join forces with their spouses in a three-course competition where Guy Fieri tests their cooking chops and communication skills; the couples have one hour to make a date-night dinner with an on-the-fly dessert.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S41 E03 — Extreme Express Lane
In the most extreme express lane challenge ever, Guy Fieri gives three all-star chefs one hour to make an upscale appetizer, entrée, and dessert using a total of only 12 ingredients! The winner gets to shop Flavortown Market for up to $20,000.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S40 E08 — All-Star Pizza
Guy Fieri invites all-star chefs Maneet Chauhan, Christian Petroni, Adam Sobel and Stephanie Izard for a pizza showdown; the pie makers must serve up a pizzeria combo plate using only the grocery items they can carry on a pizza paddle.
